ENGLISH LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A word has two meanings in the dictionary. What should you do? (1 mark)
   A. Choose the meaning that fits your sentence
   B. Ignore both
   C. Use the last meaning always
   D. Use the first meaning always

2. What should you do before you read a story? (1 mark)
   A. Write the answers
   B. Read the title and look at the pictures
   C. Close the book
   D. Read the last page only

3. In 'The Purse in the Market', what did Neema do with the purse? (1 mark)
   A. She returned it to its owner
   B. She threw it away
   C. She sold it
   D. She kept it

4. To skim a text means to (1 mark)
   A. copy it
   B. look for one word only
   C. memorise it
   D. read quickly to get the main idea

5. Language patterns: Which sentence is correct? (1 mark)
   A. We have enough chairs for sit.
   B. We have enough chair to sit on.
   C. We have chairs enough to sit on.
   D. We have enough chairs to sit on.

6. Which sentence has a lot of a noun we cannot count? (1 mark)
   A. We have a lot of chairs.
   B. We have a lot of rain in April.
   C. We have a lot of cows.
   D. We have a lot of pupils.

7. Which describes the letter b? (1 mark)
   A. A stick that goes below the line
   B. A round part with the stick on its right
   C. A stick with the round part on its right
   D. A dot only

8. Which word contains the blend 'tr'? (1 mark)
   A. train
   B. clap
   C. flag
   D. snake

9. On a map, the four main directions are (1 mark)
   A. front, back, near and far
   B. north, south, east and west
   C. red, blue, green and yellow
   D. up, down, left and right

10. Which word is a pronoun? (1 mark)
   A. she
   B. green
   C. bridge
   D. quickly

11. Which date form is correct in a letter? (1 mark)
   A. 14th May 2026
   B. 14 2026 May
   C. May 2026 14th
   D. 2026 May 14

12. What punctuation mark follows the greeting 'Dear Achieng'? (1 mark)
   A. A comma
   B. A question mark
   C. A colon
   D. A full stop

13. Which foods help the body to grow? (1 mark)
   A. Sugar and salt
   B. Beans, eggs, fish and meat
   C. Tea only
   D. Air

14. Listening and diet: Which word has the sound /æ/? (1 mark)
   A. food
   B. fruit
   C. apple
   D. juice

15. Dialogues: Which question is factual? (1 mark)
   A. Why do you think Baraka was excited?
   B. Who wanted to talk to Grandmother?
   C. What lesson does the story teach?
   D. How do you think Achieng felt?

16. What should Neema do if a message frightens her? (1 mark)
   A. Show a grown-up at once
   B. Keep it secret
   C. Reply
   D. Share her password

17. Why is it good to write new words and meanings in a notebook while reading? (1 mark)
   A. It replaces reading
   B. It makes the book shorter
   C. It helps you remember them
   D. It is required by law

18. What is extensive reading? (1 mark)
   A. Copying notes from the board
   B. Choosing materials and reading a lot on your own for pleasure and learning
   C. Studying one text word by word with the teacher
   D. Reading only for a test

19. Which time word usually goes with the present progressive? (1 mark)
   A. last night
   B. in 2010
   C. yesterday
   D. at the moment

20. In the passage about Mama Neema's farm, why does she call weeds thieves? (1 mark)
   A. They steal tools from the shed
   B. They eat the goats
   C. They take the children's lunch
   D. They steal water and food from the maize

21. What did Baraka do that showed he was a good friend? (1 mark)
   A. He told the others to stay away
   B. He ran away
   C. He explained the facts and invited Omondi to play
   D. He laughed at Omondi

22. How does your voice usually change at the end of a question? (1 mark)
   A. It goes down
   B. It becomes silent
   C. It stays flat
   D. It goes up

23. Which sentence is punctuated correctly? (1 mark)
   A. We bought rice, beans and maize.
   B. We bought rice, beans, and, maize.
   C. We bought rice beans and maize.
   D. We bought, rice beans and maize.

24. How long should you rub your hands when washing them, according to the text? (1 mark)
   A. About twenty seconds
   B. About ten minutes
   C. There is no time needed
   D. About two seconds

25. Which conjunction shows a result? 'The floor was dirty, ____ we mopped it.' (1 mark)
   A. so
   B. yet
   C. nor
   D. or

26. Which is NOT one of the five senses? (1 mark)
   A. sleep
   B. taste
   C. sight
   D. smell

27. Which word has the long vowel /ɔː/? (1 mark)
   A. door
   B. mud
   C. bus
   D. cup

28. What is an advertisement? (1 mark)
   A. A news story
   B. A weather report
   C. A letter to the editor
   D. A notice that tries to sell something

29. Which preposition shows movement to the inside? (1 mark)
   A. beside
   B. into
   C. behind
   D. on

30. Which word is a preposition of position? (1 mark)
   A. happy
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. under

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Give two reasons why we plan before writing a story. (2 marks)

32. List three parts of a diary entry. (3 marks)

33. Write the short forms of: did not, she has, we will, let us. (4 marks)

34. List three things that make handwriting legible. (3 marks)

35. Choose the correct word in each: (a) I (know / no) the answer. (b) They put (their / there) bags (their / there). (3 marks)

36. Write four descriptive sentences about your classroom. (4 marks)

37. Write the -ing form of each verb: make, run, play, lie. (4 marks)

38. Tell in three sentences how to set up a reading club. (3 marks)

39. Write the missing forms: good, better, ___ ; bad, ___ , worst; many, more, ___ . (3 marks)

40. Explain the difference between 'who' and 'whose'. Give one question for each. (3 marks)

41. Write two minimal pairs for /p/ and /b/. (2 marks)

42. What kind of person is Baraka? Give one reason from the story. (3 marks)

43. Sort into countable and uncountable: rice, mango, time, book. (2 marks)

44. Write directions to walk from the school to the market on the map in the lesson. (3 marks)

45. Punctuate: 'mama may i go to the shop' (2 marks)

46. Rewrite in the past tense: 'Baraka types a message and clicks Send.' (2 marks)

47. Explain the difference between 'it's' and 'its' with one sentence for each. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — MOCK EXAM #7 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Choose the meaning that fits your sentence
   Read all meanings and choose the one that matches how the word is used.

2. B — Read the title and look at the pictures
   The title and pictures help you predict.

3. A — She returned it to its owner
   Neema found the woman and returned the purse.

4. D — read quickly to get the main idea
   Skimming gives you the general idea.

5. D — We have enough chairs to sit on.
   The pattern is enough + noun + to + verb.

6. B — We have a lot of rain in April.
   Rain cannot be counted.

7. C — A stick with the round part on its right
   For b the stick is on the left and the round part on the right.

8. A — train
   Train begins with t and r.

9. B — north, south, east and west
   These are called the cardinal points.

10. A — she
   She takes the place of a noun.

11. A — 14th May 2026
   The usual order is day, month, year.

12. A — A comma
   A comma follows the greeting.

13. B — Beans, eggs, fish and meat
   They contain protein.

14. C — apple
   Apple has /æ/.

15. B — Who wanted to talk to Grandmother?
   The answer is written in the text.

16. A — Show a grown-up at once
   A trusted adult can help.

17. C — It helps you remember them
   Writing new words helps you remember them.

18. B — Choosing materials and reading a lot on your own for pleasure and learning
   Extensive reading is wide, independent reading.

19. D — at the moment
   'At the moment' shows an action happening now.

20. D — They steal water and food from the maize
   The passage says weeds steal water and food from the maize.

21. C — He explained the facts and invited Omondi to play
   Baraka used facts to help.

22. D — It goes up
   A question ends with a rising voice.

23. A — We bought rice, beans and maize.
   Commas separate items in a list and 'and' comes before the last.

24. A — About twenty seconds
   Rub for about twenty seconds, then rinse.

25. A — so
   'So' shows result.

26. A — sleep
   The senses are sight, sound, smell, touch and taste.

27. A — door
   'Door' has /ɔː/; the others have the short /ʌ/.

28. D — A notice that tries to sell something
   Adverts try to sell.

29. B — into
   'Into' shows movement from outside to inside.

30. D — under
   'Under' shows where something is.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: It puts ideas in order and makes sure we do not forget important events.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Day and date; greeting (Dear Diary); body (events and feelings); sign-off. Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (4 marks)
   Answer: didn't, she's, we'll, let's
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

34. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters of the correct size, letters sitting on the line, even gaps between letters and words, correct spelling.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: (a) know (b) their, there
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct choice.

36. (4 marks)
   Answer: Any four correct descriptive sentences with capitals and full stops.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

37. (4 marks)
   Answer: making, running, playing, lying
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct spelling.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: Agree on a regular time and a quiet place. Each member reads a book they have chosen. Take turns to tell the group about it and keep a list of the books read.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sensible sentence.

39. (3 marks)
   Answer: best; worse; most
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: 'Who' asks about a person: Who is the coach? 'Whose' asks about the owner: Whose ball is this?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 for examples.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example: pin, bin and pat, bat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: He is kind and brave. He went to talk to Omondi, explained the facts and invited him to play.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a quality and 2 for the evidence.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: Countable: mango, book. Uncountable: rice, time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: Walk east to the roundabout, go straight east across the foot bridge and you will reach the market.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for east, 1 mark for the roundabout and 1 mark for the foot bridge and market.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mama, may I go to the shop?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for capitals and comma, 1 for the question mark.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: Baraka typed a message and clicked Send.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each verb.

47. (4 marks)
   Answer: It's means 'it is' or 'it has': It's raining. Its shows belonging: The dog wagged its tail.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning and 1 mark for each correct sentence.
